title: Agentic Engineering Coaching
description: Field-deploying agentic engineering practice with software teams. Disciplined coding-agent workflow staged as research -> plan -> implement -> validate, with context-window hygiene to fight context rot. Productized in a custom Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI template that orchestrates the stages through skills, label-driven state, hooks, and a Ralph-style autonomous harness that closes the issue-to-PR loop hands-free.

title: Foundry NextGen Labs
description: Live-fire exercises across Microsoft Foundry NextGen, Azure's unified PaaS for enterprise AI. Hub-spoke Bicep stand-up, then every capability put through its paces: agents, MCP tool servers, Foundry IQ knowledge bases, distillation, guardrails, PyRIT red-teaming, deep-research loops, real-time observability.

title: Ontology Underwriting Agent
description: Distills HTML impairment guidance into an OWL 2 knowledge graph that returns evidence-backed rating decisions in seconds. Multi-stage extraction pipeline feeds the graph, with a LangGraph agent answering over NL to SPARQL through a FastAPI SSE chat UI.

title: Foundry Booth Op
description: Held down the Foundry Control Plane booth at Microsoft AI Tour Zurich. Live demos of the unified Azure surface that tames a fleet of AI agents through one place for controls, observability, security, and governance.

title: Foundry Drop Zone
description: Drops a production Foundry NextGen LZ on Azure in a single terraform apply, securing the perimeter with private-network isolation. APIM hub fronts two workload-segmented accounts with isolated capability hosts and subscription-key routing.

title: Vault Compiler
description: Working build of Andrej Karpathy's LLM-Wiki idea: the LLM does knowledgebase compilation and management so humans and agents get pre-computed structure instead of re-reasoning every query. 4,000+ markdown notes graphified into a compounding knowledge graph; nightly scans pull 43 frontier researchers (Karpathy, LeCun, and others) into a disposable inbox; vault-ingest writes schema-compliant pages; GitHub Actions enforce bidirectional reciprocity and type integrity.

title: Azure ML Field Drill
description: Full-lifecycle Azure ML field drill for a global insurer's data team. One hands-on day moves from data prep through AutoML, training, deployment, evaluation, and MLOps wiring; every stage worked at the keyboard.

title: Pharma GenAI Drills
description: Multi-session GenAI drill series taking a global pharma's data team from Azure GenAI fundamentals to fine-tuning. RAG, prompt engineering, SLMs, Document Intelligence, Content Understanding, and Azure AI Search threaded together, with responsible AI woven through every session for regulated-industry deployment.

title: Service Centre Copilot
description: Turned a minute of context-switching into less than 20 seconds of single conversational query across 2M+ technical documents for 5,000+ engineers; task parallelism and model optimization for the win.

title: Catalogue Matcher
description: Rivals specialist external vendors with an Azure ML product catalogue pricing matcher for a nationwide retailer. Cleansing, enrichment, and classification pipeline runs attribute-based filtering and similarity lookups across the full product catalogue, hitting vendor-grade accuracy and fully automated.

title: Airline Avatar
description: Demoed to Satya Nadella at the Microsoft AI Tour Berlin, October 2024. Conversational avatar for a leading European airline, function-calling into live organizational and customer systems so flight offers are grounded in real data.

title: Feedback Funnel
description: Routes customer feedback into product-specific streams by picking the model that wins each signal type. Empirical bake-off across BERT embeddings, XGBoost, prompt engineering, and GPT causal + sequence classifiers settled the architecture choice rather than defaulting to GPT models.

title: Summary Loadout
description: Serves seven pre-engineered summarization styles to downstream apps from a single shared GPT service: extractive, abstractive, creative, formal, keyword-based, thematic, and time-series. Teams pick the style, the service handles the prompt craft.

title: Destination Finder
description: Conversational GPT destination finder for top European airline. Passengers chat their preferences (e.g. 'surfing and architecture'); the system ranks matching destinations from a curated knowledge base against that compound profile.

title: Constitutional Judge
description: Constitutional LLM-as-judge gating a GenAI-curated destination knowledge base. Every generated answer scored on safety, accuracy, and bias before it reaches the user; failed responses are blocked, not shown.

title: Founder Advisory
description: Embedded as AI and cloud advisor inside the Microsoft Startup Accelerator Program. Per-startup rather than per-cohort: each founder gets architecture, scale, and AI adoption guidance tailored to their actual position.

title: Startup Blueprints
description: Multi-workshop drill turning startup architectures into product-evolution blueprints on Microsoft Azure. Per-company design recommendations balancing innovation, scalability, and governance; the deliverable is a working blueprint, not a slide deck.

title: Managed AI Plane
description: One central plane safely fans Azure Cognitive Services, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI out to multiple consumer teams. Single pattern locks in deployment, data privacy, secure access, usage tracking, compliance, and content moderation; designed and shipped end-to-end.

title: MLOps Chassis
description: One MLOps chassis serving many data science teams for top European airline. Azure ML + Azure DevOps YAML CI/CD + Python and CLI SDK templates ship together as a reusable pattern that lifts model-shipping quality, frequency, and efficiency. Adoption workshops included.

title: Azure ML Rollout
description: Outcome-based rollout of Azure ML PaaS for global data science teams. Terraform IaC ships network-secured workspaces, least-privilege access wires into the data lake, and reference notebooks (Python SDK v1 + v2) take teams from EDA through inference on day one.

title: Platform Observability
description: SRE-grade observability for a European airline's central data platform. SLI/SLO definitions pin telemetry to system health; Azure Policy auto-provisions diagnostics across every resource so nothing ships dark; Azure Monitor alerts and KQL queries close the loop.

title: Neuroscience KB
description: 10,000x faster than the legacy search. 30K cleansed, digitized, and enriched neuroscience research articles in a knowledge base returning sub-second answers to analysts.

title: Azure Foundations
description: Best-practice breadth across the Azure stack: IaaS, Python Function Apps, Logic Apps, containerized App Services, key vaults, event grid, storage. Application Insights telemetry, AAD RBAC + MFA + managed identities, SAS-secured blobs, subscription cost management. Built, costed, and compliant from day one.
